GLIBC-SA-2026-0024 (CVE-2026-97399) is a one-byte overread in the Power8-specific strncasecmp optimization (BZ #34683). Debian trixie glibc in DHI consumer images is built for amd64 and arm64, not PowerPC, so the vulnerable Power8 code is not compiled into the shipped libc. See https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=blob;f=advisories/GLIBC-SA-2026-0024

GLIBC-SA-2026-0023 (CVE-2026-95818) affects setuid or setgid programs whose DT_RPATH or DT_RUNPATH begins with $ORIGIN followed by NUL or '/'. DHI minimal container images do not install setuid or setgid executables.

No fixed version available for the 9.4.x branch. The Jetty 9.4.x line is EOL with the last release being 9.4.56.v20240826. Upstream Apache ZooKeeper 3.8.6 and 3.9.5 pin jetty.version=9.4.58.v20250814. Upgrading to a supported Jetty version (10.x, 11.x, or 12.x) would require migration to jakarta.servlet API, which is not currently validated for ZooKeeper's admin server.

HTTP/1.1 chunked-extension request smuggling in Jetty. Fix is published only in Jetty 9.4.60 (HeroDevs commercial extended-support backport); no public OSS release exists on the 9.4.x line. Upstream Apache ZooKeeper 3.8.6 and 3.9.5 still pin jetty.version=9.4.58.v20250814. Mitigation requires either a HeroDevs-licensed jetty-http or a major-version bump to Jetty 10/11/12 (jakarta.servlet API), neither of which is currently validated for ZooKeeper's admin server.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
